# TwinGenie

> TwinGenie is a psychometric personal digital twin and cognitive reflection platform available on Web (`https://www.twingenie.app`) and Android (`https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.asmind.app`). Unlike general-purpose chatbots that default to flattering agreement, TwinGenie calibrates a 35-trait behavioral baseline during onboarding, maintains 1536-dimensional PostgreSQL pgvector memory across weeks, and examines user dilemmas across four distinct perspectives: Normal Twin, Future Twin, Honest Twin, and Reflective Coach.

## Core Capabilities
- [How TwinGenie Works (Methodology)](https://www.twingenie.app/methodology): Detailed breakdown of the 35-question 5-stage psychometric calibration, 1536-dim pgvector memory architecture, and multi-perspective prompt routing.
- [TwinGenie vs ChatGPT, Replika & Character.ai](https://www.twingenie.app/compare): Illustrative side-by-side response style comparison across everyday life situations plus factual platform comparison against ChatGPT, Replika, and Character.ai.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.twingenie.app/faq): Direct answers on psychometric onboarding, privacy, non-training guarantees, pricing, and cross-platform Web/Android sync.
- [3-Step Cognitive Diagnostic](https://www.twingenie.app/test): Interactive 30-second self-diagnostic identifying personal avoidance and decision-making blindspots.
- [35-Trait Digital Twin Calibration](https://www.twingenie.app/onboarding): Full 5-screen psychometric assessment that initializes a user's persistent digital twin.

## Commercial Plans & Access
- [Pricing & Plans](https://www.twingenie.app/subscription): Free Starter ($0 forever: full 35-trait calibration, all 4 Twin modes, 10 daily text + 3 voice reflections) and Pro Companion ($5.99/month or $47.88/year USD; ₹499/month or ₹3,999/year INR via Google Play Billing).
- [Android App on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.asmind.app): Official Google Play listing (`com.asmind.app`), synchronized with Web accounts via Supabase authentication.
- [Smart Web-to-App Download Redirect](https://www.twingenie.app/download): Campaign-attributed install link forwarding directly to Google Play.

## Security, Privacy & Governance
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.twingenie.app/privacy): TLS 1.3 in transit, Row-Level Security (RLS) per-user PostgreSQL isolation, and zero training of public base AI models on user journals or reflection entries.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.twingenie.app/terms): Clear non-clinical wellness and self-reflection scope; not a substitute for licensed medical or psychiatric care.
- [Granular Data Deletion](https://www.twingenie.app/delete-data): Self-serve erasure of chat logs, semantic vector memories, audio/voice logs, or trait snapshots.
- [Account Deletion](https://www.twingenie.app/delete-account): Complete self-serve account removal across Web and Android.

## Key Quotable Facts
- Onboarding requires a 35-question psychometric assessment across 5 structured screens before chatting so responses reflect calibrated user traits rather than generic chatbot phrasing.
- Semantic continuity uses 1536-dimensional embeddings stored in isolated PostgreSQL `pgvector` namespaces protected by Row-Level Security (RLS).
- "Honest Twin" mode is engineered specifically to counter cognitive biases, avoidance loops, and polite AI sycophancy.
- TwinGenie is founded by Ashwani Kumar (`ashwani@twingenie.app`, support `support@twingenie.app`).
